items.title: ‘I feel shoehorned’: My father funded my $800,000 Roth IRA. Does that give him the right to say how I invest it?
items.content: “His argument is essentially that, since my parents provided the money for the Roth, they have a say in how I invest it.”

items.title: Lake America? Trump’s Lake Ontario name change creates map mayhem for Apple and Google.
items.content: Google Maps now shows different names depending on a user’s country, while a Trump administration official says Apple has been “directly” contacted by the president about making changes.

items.title: New Apple CEO John Ternus’s first big challenge: Leading when his old boss is still in the building

items.title: Are rising bond rates really so bad? Maybe not, say these experts
items.content: The near-zero interest rates that characterized the decade after the global financil crisis were a sign of economic dysfunction. Higher rates reflect a stronger demand for capital and robust economic growth.
